results.title: The Bitches
results.overview: On a journey through heartbreak, in search of transformation. The film is built through friendship: each person helps in their own way, searches for the story, translates the words into their own language, sings Emily Dickinson, joyfully mends the dress of sorrow.

results.title: Celle avec qui on a dansé
results.original_title: Celle avec qui on a dansé
results.overview: Stéphane, a man in his fifties, sells at the market in Trouville-sur-Mer the last memories he had of his relationship with Anna, his ex-wife. Through his encounters with customers, and as his own memory slowly erodes, Stéphane learns to let go of the past and opens himself to the future.

results.title: Velvet
results.overview: After being threatened with termination at her monotonous office job, a creatively stifled Plain Girl is transported into the pages of a mysterious magazine, where each surreal spread forces her to confront, and reclaim, the parts of herself previously dulled.

results.title: LOOP
results.overview: A rookie food delivery rider accepts a legendary ghost order for a small bonus—only to be trapped in a terrifying loop deep in the haunted mountains.
